title: kafka-cluster values
description: kafka-cluster 1.x. Every object the chart owns is closed (a misspelled key fails the render); pass-through objects (Strimzi config, templates) are open. Keys marked deprecated are the 0.4 shape, still translated in 1.x.

enabled.description: Set by an umbrella chart's dependency condition

kafka.description: An image reference; floating tags (:latest, untagged) are refused

kubectl.description: An image reference; floating tags (:latest, untagged) are refused

image.description: An image reference; floating tags (:latest, untagged) are refused

replicas.description: DEPRECATED (0.4): ignored; size the cluster with nodePools

accessKeyId.description: DEPRECATED (0.4): inline credentials are not rendered; use existingSecret

secretAccessKey.description: DEPRECATED (0.4): inline credentials are not rendered; use existingSecret

seaweedfs.description: Also passed to the seaweedfs subchart

dashboards.description: Kafka dashboards are the strimzi-operator chart's; the 0.4 sub-keys are ignored

crdUpgrade.description: DEPRECATED (0.4): the strimzi-operator chart owns the Strimzi CRDs

drainCleaner.description: DEPRECATED (0.4): the drain cleaner is the strimzi-operator chart's; enabled=true fails

lifecycle.description: DEPRECATED (0.4): never reached a pod; use nodePools.defaults.scheduling.terminationGracePeriodSeconds

strimziOperator.description: DEPRECATED (0.4): ignored: install the operator with the strimzi-operator chart
